user.title: Connect to the S-BUS gateway
user.description: Home Assistant must be on the same LAN subnet as the RSIP / Z-Audio gateway. You can let the integration find the gateway for you, or enter its address yourself.

reconfigure.title: Change the S-BUS gateway
reconfigure.description: Pick a new gateway address for this entry. Devices already configured are kept; the new gateway is verified with a bus scan first.

discover.title: Find the gateway
discover.description: A scan probe is broadcast on the LAN and every host that relays S-BUS module traffic back is listed as a gateway. Takes the chosen number of seconds.

select.title: Choose the gateway
select.description: {count} gateway(s) answered. Pick one, or its subnet broadcast address if you have several gateways or other S-BUS tools on the LAN. The bus is then scanned for modules for the chosen number of seconds.

manual.title: Enter the gateway
manual.description: The RSIP / Z-Audio gateway IP, or a broadcast address such as 192.168.1.255 (or 255.255.255.255). The bus is then scanned for modules on UDP port 6000 for the chosen number of seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Could not bind UDP port 6000 — is another S-BUS tool running?
error.no_gateways: No gateway relayed any module traffic. Check that Home Assistant is on the gateway's LAN, or enter the address manually.
error.no_devices: No devices answered the bus scan through this gateway.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Gateway updated; the integration is reloading.

menu_options.rescan: Rescan the bus for new modules

rescan.title: Rescan the bus
rescan.description: Scan the S-BUS again and add newly found modules. Existing devices are kept even if they miss this scan (replies are lossy). New modules appear as devices after an automatic reload.

discover.title: Find the gateway
discover.description: A scan probe is broadcast on the LAN and every host that relays S-BUS module traffic back is listed as a gateway. Takes the chosen number of seconds.

select.title: Choose the gateway
select.description: {count} gateway(s) answered. Pick one, or its subnet broadcast address. The new gateway is verified with a bus scan before it replaces the current one, then the integration reloads.

manual.title: Change the gateway
manual.description: The RSIP / Z-Audio gateway IP, or a broadcast address. The new gateway is verified with a bus scan before it replaces the current one, then the integration reloads.

error.cannot_connect: Could not bind UDP port 6000 — is another S-BUS tool running?
error.no_gateways: No gateway relayed any module traffic. Check that Home Assistant is on the gateway's LAN, or enter the address manually.
error.no_devices: No devices answered the bus scan through this gateway.
error.already_configured: Another Smart-G4 entry already uses this gateway.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded — fix the connection first.
